<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-07-0803-04-25" status="unreviewed">'ong sngar du ba 3 dang myad du ba'i rang gi
               <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="N007"/> mtshan nyid du bshad pa dang | 'dir spyi'i mtshan nyid du 'chad pa
            'gal lo zhe na | mi 'gal te snga ni du la khyad po so so ba dang ra so so ba mtshid du
            bkod pa yin la | 'dir shi ra bsdos pa dang rgyar ba sngos pa mtshan nyid yin pa las zhes
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4243">'ban</rs> zer || 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3921">tho</rs> nar du kha 2 dang phyad la sngo ma bstod pa pas de ni ma yin gyi | 
            'on kyang du la 2 dang myad bshad pa ni mdo' las 'byung ma bshad pa yin la <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="N008"/>
            'di na dang rgyad bshad pa ni mdo'i las 'byung ba de nyid du la'i spyi'i mtshid du bshad
            pa yin pas mi 'gal lo zhes zer ||</seg></TEI>
